text: The introduction said the series is built from 700 copies of the register, 31 Jan 2014 to 22 Jul 2025, plus 4 copies since 19 May 2026. 700 was every usable copy, so it counted the 4 reformed-regime copies twice and the 2 copies left out by the partial-export rule as used. The old-regime series is built from 694 copies. No movement figure changed.
old: 700 copies of the register, 31 Jan 2014 to 22 Jul 2025, plus 4 copies since 19 May 2026
new: 694 copies of the register, 31 Jan 2014 to 22 Jul 2025, plus 4 copies since 19 May 2026
